description: Applies edits without asking in Claude Code; other harnesses ask as usual.
mode: subagent
permission:
  '*': deny
  bash: allow
  edit: allow
  glob: allow
  grep: allow
  read:
    '*': allow
    '*.env': ask
    '*.env.*': ask
    '*.env.example': allow
---
Apply the requested edits.
